name: Beach Buddies
description_short: Half day town camp for children ages 3.5 to 5 at the Wayland Town Beach, with weekly themes, stories, songs, art, games, nature walks and supervised water play. Children must be toilet trained.
refund_policy_summary: Written withdrawals: free before March 15; then credit or refund less $25 to $50 depending on the date; no credit or refund within ten business days of the camp week without a doctor's note. No proration or make-up days.
swim_waterfront_notes: No swim tests; every Beach Buddy is treated as a non-swimmer, wears a fitted life jacket and stays in the non-swimmer area, supervised at 1 to 5 by staff plus at least one lifeguard.

sources.note: Researched by Claude from this page. Ages 3.5 to 5, toilet trained. Monday to Friday 9:00 to 1:00 at Wayland Town Beach, 25 Parkland Drive. 25 camper maximum. 2027 dates; no prices posted. age_min 3 stands for 3.5.

Researched by Claude from this page. Registration page lists Beach Buddies as ages 3.5 to 5.5. ZIP 01778 is the Town of Wayland ZIP printed in this page's footer (Town offices, 41 Cochituate Road); the camp page gives the street address without a ZIP.
Researched by Claude from this page. Families pack a non-perishable lunch and snacks.
